coverage.heapGcWatchRetention: Real API listener, configured heap/counters, omitted unobserved GC, bounded history labels and read-only sampling.
coverage.raft: Local progress/retention/compaction and phase critical-section telemetry; bounded configured-peer receipt freshness after normal dispatch.
coverage.datastore: Actual statvfs bytes/inodes, explicit unavailable/absent semantics, growth and selected-generation versus stable WAL paths.
coverage.reconciliation: Worker attempts, errors, normal and abnormal completion, live worker recovery, leader gate and fixed-kind observed-generation lag.
coverage.documentation: docs/control-plane-metrics.md documents local sampling, resets, fixed labels, error semantics and attribution limits.

limitations: Initial invocation included a nonexistent main suite selector, which ran nothing; no coverage is claimed for it. Both required reconciliation tests were rerun explicitly and their existence checked.
Telemetry reports local observations; it does not establish quorum health, workload readiness, total state disk usage, or a cluster-wide atomic snapshot.
